title: Replace the README with AGENTS.md, keep skills generic, cover answers in coding-comms
body:
Moves the content of `README.md` into `AGENTS.md` and deletes `README.md`. GitHub does not show `AGENTS.md` on the repository's front page.

- `AGENTS.md`: adds a rule for agents that change this repo: keep every skill generic, and do not fit a skill to the case that prompted the change.
- `coding-comms`: adds answers to questions to the scope, with a template: the answer first, in the asker's words, at about the question's length.
- `coding-comms`: adds three rules: use the passive when it puts the thing the reader asked about first; use only the markup that the destination renders; show the whole text again after each revision.

Tested: the `coding-comms` changes are not tested on clean agents.
